method.timing: Uninstrumented production React and plugin. CDP TaskDuration / ScriptDuration deltas in milliseconds; includes fixture event dispatch and DOM work, excludes idle waits. One warm-up pair discarded, measured pairs alternate order.
method.counts: Separate instrumented run; publish counts actual subscriber notifications, not attempted calls. 100 updates are separate tasks, not one synchronous batch.
method.scope: Isolated browser with mock public host stores and 2000 output paragraphs; not DSH end-to-end FPS, memory, power or CPU percentage.
